programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Venture along Earth’s coasts, where colliding worlds create a melting pot of biodiversity. Watch orcas hunt with precision, hold on as guillemot chicks take leaps of faith, crawl to safety with turtle hatchlings, and see crabs sculpt sandy galaxies.

director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russia’s far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earth’s most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

director: Andrew Zikking: Executive Producer, Laura Coates: Series Producer

programs.title: Kingdom of the Tide
programs.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It’s a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programs.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programs.desc: Dive to the darkest depths of the sea to uncover the ocean’s most mysterious inhabitants. Journey across vast stretches of open water with humpback whales, then wander down to the ocean floor to witness breathtaking bioluminescence.
